evidence.finding: Provider adapters launch host processes in a project checkout or managed Git worktree. The scoped process runner and adapters have no product container or per-agent VM provisioning backend; worktree separation is not a security sandbox.

evidence.title: Synara shared task dispatch and session authorization
evidence.locator: wsRpc.ts dispatchCommand handler; wsConnectionSessions.ts registry; wsOwnerOnly.ts; packages/contracts/src/auth.ts
evidence.finding: Authenticated browser connections reach the same server orchestration dispatch handler and task/thread state.
